children.text: Run the module in a subprocess and capture stdout/stderr:

Share your module with the GeoID community via GitHub.

Steps to publish:
  1. Fork the GeoID community modules repo
  2. Copy your .py file into the /modules directory
  3. Update modules/index.json with your module metadata
  4. Open a pull request — the team will review and merge

Your module will then appear in the 'Browse Community Modules' section
and other users can install it with one click.

Community repo (future):  https://github.com/geoid-org/modules
